baseline: Q_A projection -> q_norm producing BF16 qr -> ordinary DynamicQuant producing INT8 plus FLOAT row scale -> Q_B quantized projection. Indexer projection also consumes qr in its applicable source branch.
proposed_scope: Fuse q_norm and ordinary row DynamicQuant while retaining original BF16 rounding, full-row normalization/amax and any live BF16/rstd outputs. Q_B projection remains unless a separately selected extension is validated.
known_input_domain: QR hidden width1280 in saved native signatures; not FFN norm5120; per-head Indexer query128 FP16-scale quant is a different operation.
input_adapter_limit: PreparedLinearInput is supported at the recorded W8 quant_method.apply boundary; this does not prove every Linear wrapper/TP/bias/output path accepts it.

logical_example.if_other_BF16_readers_live: retain the QR write; a fused local consumer may avoid one selected 7680B read
logical_example.if_all_BF16_readers_legally_adapted: write+read interface up to15360B; stronger domain,not proved

public_library_limit: Pinned public AddRmsNormDynamicQuant keys1/2 quantize FLOAT normalized values without original BF16 normalized roundtrip; not a proved drop-in. Other keys or installed9.2 objects not thereby ruled out.
not_established: new fused implementation and consumer interface
on-chip row storage and resource scheduling
excluded_subvariants_this_review: common QR quant producer for Q_B/IndexQ
